items.title: Dragon Pals
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Are you ready to put on your costume and become a dragon today?

- 13 dragon skins

items.title: Hero Squad
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
What time is it? Time to save the world! The world is in need of the best heroes, and you are the perfect match. So it's time for you to suit up, take your gear and fight against evil. Put on your favorite outfit out of 7 different hero skins.

+ 7 hero skins

+ By Agora Studios

items.title: Ninja Mobs
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Ninja mobs are super cool! Watch out for the black belt spider! Which mob is your favorite? Each mob comes with their own custom colored belt, and attire. These ninjas are perfect for a stylish adventure.

- Ninja mobs
- Perfect for roleplay
- Cool and cute designs
- Perfect for teens
- Great for roleplay

items.title: Lucky Block Temple
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
You've never played with lucky blocks like this! Travel to the oldest lucky block temple known to mankind and try to survive the traps that were hidden by ancient civilization!
Can you find them all?

+ By DalibuStudios

items.title: Billionaire City Life
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Sports cars, yachts, private helicopter, limo, modern mansions and unlimited money! That is the billionaire city life! Furnish your luxury apartment, huge villa or office building with the lots of furniture options! Are you ready to spend all those millions? Explore the huge mall and buy everything you want!

+Furniture!
+Huge city!
+Lots of vehicles!
+including 16 skins!

items.title: Salad People
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Keep it fresh with the Salad People skin pack! Showcase your love for delicious fresh fruits and vegetables with this skin pack made of healthy food!

- Hand-crafted HD skins with one free skin!
- Inspired by healthy food
- By 57Digital

items.title: Ninja Chicks
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Hiiiiii-YA! Uh, we mean - cluck, cluck, cluck! Roleplay as these adorable chicks who love to do one thing, and one thing only - ninja roleplay!

- Six hand-crafted HD skins
- One skin free
- By 57Digital

items.title: Mods & Rockers
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
No matter what your music preference is - I think we can all agree that these skins rock! Put on your ride of choice and ride into the sunset.

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: SportHeads
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description: True sports fans go over the top for their game, and these fans are in over their heads! More than mascots, these players wear inflated basketballs, winking tennis balls, giant soccer balls - ain’t that a kick in the head? Volleyball will never be the same when diving headfirst, so show your love of play with these 11 competitive skins and get your head in the game!

items.title: Anime Gothic
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description: It’s time to spotlight the dark and the dangerous, anime’s most devious goths! Style and fashion vary from wristbands, torn leggings, black dresses and stripes to skull masks, blood motifs, and comfortable hoodies, but they are all goth. Demons and witches, the cute and the cruel, this animated collection contains 12 iconic skins to steal looks, hearts, and souls!

items.title: Glitch Teens
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description: The next generation of technology is here, spliced with gen z teenagers! Now they must undergo the true test: prom week! Social skills and mathematical calculation, empathy, and chemistry all wrapped into a stressful celebration of digital youth. Prepare to dance, prepare to compute, prepare to explore the electronic horizon with 9 synthetic silicon skins!

items.title: Embers
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description: Where there is smoke, there is fire. Where there is fire, there are embers and boy do they burn hot! Heat up your game with one of these embers inspired skins.

items.title: City Hackers
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Shh! Dressed in your everyday clothes, who will know you’re really a hacker? With lots of different skins, maybe you will wear a mask, or not. Either way, you can role-play with cyber skills and break into systems all over Minecraft.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Cool Pets
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Who doesn’t want a cool buddy by their side? Furry like a hamster or rabbit. Maybe with feathers or a shell. Either way, these are the coolest pets of all. Choose from 8 options and role-play as the most relaxed best friend a human could ever have!

Adorable textures!
1 free skin included!

items.title: Lucky Block Teens
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These blocky teens are full of surprises! Who knows what lucky treasures they hold!

- 16 lucky block skins

items.title: Clowns
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description:
Will you be making people laugh at your silly jokes, or will you be getting the last laugh? Choose from good and evil clown skins.

- Includes one free skin

items.title: Glow Bellies
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: Inside each of these skins is a glowing gem! Look how it glows inside their body.

items.title: Neons
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
These colorful neon skins sure are pretty to look at. Almost sucks you in if you stare long enough... Have fun with these neon skins! Perfect for any occasion! Need some extra neon light? Need a neon sign in front of your new cottage store? Have a neon party! The possibilities are endless!

-24 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Rockstars
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
It's about time you joined a band of rockstars! Rock out and go crazy! The world has been waiting to hear you play! A little face paint never hurt anyone anyways.

- 5 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Pretty Patterns
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Patterns are so pretty and mesmerizing! Become a super cool pattern that is fun and interesting to look at! Everyone will stop and stare at you!

- 12 pattern skins

items.title: Parkour Games
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
Get your running shoes on in this fun and exciting map!

Challenge your friends and visit the diamond dungeon, horror house, jungle temple, and more!

- 9 fun levels
- Score system
- Resetting courses

Push your parkour skills to the limit and download this exclusive Minecraft map now!

items.title: Valentines Club!
items.creator: Black Arts Studios
items.description:
Roses are red, violets are blue, this skin pack was made for you! Spend this Valentine's Day with your soul mate with one of these heartfelt characters... Or you're just feeling particularly sweet and want to be the cutest one in town, these skins are for you!

+ Includes 14 skins
+ By: Black Arts Studios

items.title: Anime Cute Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Anime cute teens hit the Marketplace! Beautiful anime style skins which will make you look very good, you will attract attention wherever you go. What are you waiting for?

- 12 anime cute teens skins
- Perfect for roleplay
- By Pixelusion & CubePlanet

items.title: Nethbots
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Another invasion of the Nether but this time by the ultimate mechanical conquerors who named themselves Nethbots. Their plan did not stop in the Nether, they are planning to invade the whole world this time! What can you do about it?

- 27 epic bot skins
+ 1 free skin!
- Perfect for roleplay!
- by Pixelusion and Lostduckies
